reports.title: McGrath Announces Results for Third Quarter 2026

guidance.heading: financial outlook
section: Based upon the Company's year-to-date results and current outlook for the remainder of the year, the Company is updating its financial outlook. Total revenues is decreasing as a result of lower Mobile Modular new equipment sales. Adjusted EBITDA range has narrowed with no change to mid-point expectations. Gross rental equipment capital expenditures are increasing to support rental operations momentum at Mobile Modular and TRS-RenTelco. For the remainder of 2026, the Company currently expects:

Previous | Current
• | Total revenue: | $955 to $985 million | $945 to $960 million
• | Adjusted EBITDA1, 2: | $363 to $375 million | $365 to $373 million
• | Gross rental equipment capital expenditures: | $200 to $220 million | $270 to $290 million
